## Purpose

This report compares the outputs of `scripts/create_final_data.R` and
`scripts/create_final_data_copilot.R`. It reads the already-generated CSV files;
it does not rerun either data-creation script. The comparison covers dataset
size, schema, country-year keys, and values in variables shared by both files.
After changing either creation script, rerun it to refresh its CSV before
rendering this report.

The original workflow writes `data/processed/final_data.csv`; the Copilot
workflow writes `data/processed/final_data_copilot.csv`.

## Load the outputs

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

original <- read_csv(
	"../data/processed/final_data.csv",
	show_col_types = FALSE
)

copilot <- read_csv(
	"../data/processed/final_data_copilot.csv",
	show_col_types = FALSE
)

key <- c("iso", "year")
```

## Dataset size and key integrity

Both outputs currently contain one row per country-year. The table below
recalculates the dimensions and duplicate-key counts from the files at render
time.

```{r}
dataset_overview <- tribble(
	~dataset, ~rows, ~columns, ~duplicate_country_year_keys,
	"Original", nrow(original), ncol(original),
	original |> count(across(all_of(key))) |> filter(n > 1) |> nrow(),
	"Copilot", nrow(copilot), ncol(copilot),
	copilot |> count(across(all_of(key))) |> filter(n > 1) |> nrow()
)

kable(dataset_overview, caption = "Dimensions and key uniqueness")
```

Compare the distinct country-year keys to identify records that occur in only
one output.

```{r}
original_keys <- original |> distinct(across(all_of(key)))
copilot_keys <- copilot |> distinct(across(all_of(key)))

key_comparison <- bind_rows(
	anti_join(original_keys, copilot_keys, by = key) |>
		mutate(present_in = "Original only"),
	anti_join(copilot_keys, original_keys, by = key) |>
		mutate(present_in = "Copilot only")
) |>
	count(present_in, name = "country_years")

if (nrow(key_comparison) == 0) {
	tibble(result = "The two outputs contain the same country-year keys.")
} else {
	key_comparison
}
```

## Column names and types

Columns are classified as shared, exclusive to one output, or shared with a
different inferred data type.

```{r}
original_types <- map_chr(original, ~ paste(class(.x), collapse = "/"))
copilot_types <- map_chr(copilot, ~ paste(class(.x), collapse = "/"))

schema_comparison <- tibble(
	variable = union(names(original), names(copilot)),
	original_type = original_types[variable],
	copilot_type = copilot_types[variable]
) |>
	mutate(
		status = case_when(
			is.na(original_type) ~ "Copilot only",
			is.na(copilot_type) ~ "Original only",
			original_type != copilot_type ~ "Type differs",
			TRUE ~ "Shared"
		)
	)

schema_comparison |> count(status, name = "columns")
```

```{r}
schema_comparison |>
	filter(status != "Shared") |>
	arrange(status, variable)
```

## Compare values in corresponding columns

The comparison aligns records by `iso` and `year`. In addition to columns with
the same name, it pairs renamed measures with their likely counterparts:
original `armed_conflict` with Copilot `armed_conflict_lag1`, and original
`drought`/`earthquake` with Copilot `disaster_drought`/`disaster_earthquake`.
The directly named `armed_conflict` columns are also compared. The comparison
is meaningful when both files have unique country-year keys; duplicate-key
counts above flag when that assumption does not hold. Missing values are
treated as differences when they occur in only one file.

```{r}
comparison_pairs <- tibble(
	original_variable = intersect(names(original), names(copilot)),
	copilot_variable = intersect(names(original), names(copilot))
) |>
	filter(!original_variable %in% key) |>
	bind_rows(
		tribble(
			~original_variable, ~copilot_variable,
			"armed_conflict", "armed_conflict_lag1",
			"drought", "disaster_drought",
			"earthquake", "disaster_earthquake"
		) |>
			filter(
				original_variable %in% names(original),
				copilot_variable %in% names(copilot)
			)
	) |>
	mutate(
		comparison = if_else(
			original_variable == copilot_variable,
			original_variable,
			paste(original_variable, "vs", copilot_variable)
		)
	)

value_differences <- tibble(
	iso = character(),
	year = integer(),
	comparison = character(),
	original_value = character(),
	copilot_value = character()
)
value_comparison_run <- FALSE

if (anyDuplicated(original[key]) == 0 && anyDuplicated(copilot[key]) == 0) {
	value_comparison_run <- TRUE
	value_differences <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(comparison_pairs)), function(i) {
		original_variable <- comparison_pairs$original_variable[[i]]
		copilot_variable <- comparison_pairs$copilot_variable[[i]]
		pair_data <- full_join(
			original |>
				select(all_of(key), original_value = all_of(original_variable)),
			copilot |>
				select(all_of(key), copilot_value = all_of(copilot_variable)),
			by = key
		)
		original_value <- pair_data$original_value
		copilot_value <- pair_data$copilot_value
		original_text <- as.character(original_value)
		copilot_text <- as.character(copilot_value)
		differs <- xor(is.na(original_text), is.na(copilot_text)) |
			(!is.na(original_text) & !is.na(copilot_text) &
				 original_text != copilot_text)

		tibble(
			iso = pair_data$iso[differs],
			year = pair_data$year[differs],
			comparison = comparison_pairs$comparison[[i]],
			original_value = original_text[differs],
			copilot_value = copilot_text[differs]
		)
	})

	difference_summary <- value_differences |>
		count(comparison, name = "country_years_different") |>
		arrange(desc(country_years_different), comparison)

	if (nrow(difference_summary) == 0) {
		tibble(result = "All shared-variable values match for aligned keys.")
	} else {
		difference_summary
	}
} else {
	tibble(result = paste(
		"Value comparison skipped: at least one output has duplicate",
		"country-year keys. Review key integrity above before joining."
	))
}
```

Show a small sample of differing values, if any.

```{r}
if (value_comparison_run && nrow(value_differences) > 0) {
	value_differences |> slice_head(n = 20)
} else if (value_comparison_run) {
	tibble(result = "No differences to display.")
} else {
	tibble(result = "No value-level comparison was produced.")
}
```

## Compare the conflict indicators directly

The original `armed_conflict` is shifted forward one year during preparation,
so compare it with the Copilot `armed_conflict_lag1` for the same country-year.
The table reports agreement only among aligned records where both indicators
are observed, and separately counts missing values.

```{r}
if (anyDuplicated(original[key]) == 0 && anyDuplicated(copilot[key]) == 0) {
	conflict_comparison <- inner_join(
		original |>
			select(all_of(key), original_armed_conflict = armed_conflict),
		copilot |>
			select(all_of(key), copilot_armed_conflict_lag1 = armed_conflict_lag1),
		by = key
	)

	conflict_observed <- conflict_comparison |>
		filter(
			!is.na(original_armed_conflict),
			!is.na(copilot_armed_conflict_lag1)
		)

	conflict_summary <- tibble(
		aligned_country_years = nrow(conflict_comparison),
		observed_in_both = nrow(conflict_observed),
		agreeing = sum(
			conflict_observed$original_armed_conflict ==
				conflict_observed$copilot_armed_conflict_lag1
		),
		disagreeing = sum(
			conflict_observed$original_armed_conflict !=
				conflict_observed$copilot_armed_conflict_lag1
		),
		missing_original = sum(is.na(conflict_comparison$original_armed_conflict)),
		missing_copilot_lag1 = sum(
			is.na(conflict_comparison$copilot_armed_conflict_lag1)
		),
		agreement_rate = if_else(
			nrow(conflict_observed) > 0,
			mean(
				conflict_observed$original_armed_conflict ==
					conflict_observed$copilot_armed_conflict_lag1
			),
			NA_real_
		)
	)

	kable(conflict_summary, digits = 3)
} else {
	tibble(result = paste(
		"Conflict indicator comparison skipped because country-year keys",
		"are not unique in both outputs."
	))
}
```

The following table lists up to 20 aligned country-years where both indicators
are observed but disagree.

```{r}
if (exists("conflict_observed")) {
	conflict_observed |>
		filter(
			original_armed_conflict != copilot_armed_conflict_lag1
		) |>
		slice_head(n = 20)
} else {
	tibble(result = "No conflict-indicator comparison was produced.")
}
```

## Interpretation notes

The outputs do not use identical names or definitions for all measures, so a
raw comparison of matching column names is not sufficient:

- The original workflow shifts the conflict year forward by one and stores
	that lagged indicator as `armed_conflict`. The Copilot workflow keeps the
	same-year indicator as `armed_conflict` and adds
	`armed_conflict_lag1`. Compare the original `armed_conflict` with
	Copilot's `armed_conflict_lag1` to assess the corresponding lagged measure.
- Disaster variables are named `drought` and `earthquake` in the original
	output, versus `disaster_drought` and `disaster_earthquake` in the Copilot
	output. These are not counted as shared columns above.
- The original disaster preparation filters to 2000–2019. After merging, the
	original workflow replaces missing `drought` and `earthquake` values with
	zero; it also replaces unmatched `armed_conflict` values with zero. The
	Copilot workflow does not apply the same disaster-year filter and replaces
	unmatched conflict and disaster flags with zero.
- The Copilot workflow can restrict records to ISO codes found in
	`data/raw/countries.txt`; the original workflow does not apply this filter.

Consequently, differences may reflect changed construction choices rather
than accidental data errors. Interpret the value-difference tables alongside
these definitions, especially for conflict timing and disaster indicators.
